utterances.text: Thank you very much. Mayor, members of the council. Yes. The first item is our, as noted, the first quarter budget update. This is hopefully becoming a routine item, more or less, to provide the council and the public with periodic updates on the basically revenue and expenditures over the course of the fiscal year in relation to our approved budget. I'll just summarize that. Most of fiscal information is provided in the attachment to the report where we show the revenues collected, in this case through the accounting period ending September 30, 2025, and revenues collected of about 27 million against a budget of 195 million. So about 14% of the fiscal year revenues on the expenditures. The expenditures were $48.5 million through the first quarter. When combined with encumbrances, it's about 32%. Excuse me, 34% of the budget. The encumbrances merely reflect contracts and purchase orders that have been let so not yet paid, but commitments essentially of city funds against those budgets. The report goes on to highlight the results within the general fund where we received about 8.3%, $8.6 million of revenues. They tend to lag the sort of timing through the fiscal year because of the delay in property and sales tax receipts that received quarterly, not necessarily within the the accounting period, but they seem to be tracking on budget. We then cover the expenditures through the first quarter of the fiscal year. About 30% of the general fund expended at 3 million against the budget of 112.5. Again that also reflects the number of encumbrances. So money not yet out the door, but contractual commitments, things like our contracts with the county general services for animal control, some of the homeless service contracts that are in place. And then we provide more detailed report in Table 7 and 8 of these attachments relative to all the specific funds. So we're providing a little bit more information. Sometimes it could be too much information, but it allows again the council and the public to track our progress. I will note that when we present a mid year budget update, typically second meeting in February, we will also be providing updated revenue and expenditure projections through the end of the fiscal year to not just report a point in time result, but where the trends are heading. We tend not to do that in the first quarter because the year is still relatively young and as we like to say, one data point is not a trend make. But as we get through the next few accounting periods and through the midyear, we'll be able to update our projections through the end of the fiscal year. The other thing that I would note is the second part of this report, which is just a recommendation and the detail is in attachment B. The council adopted the current fiscal year budget at their meeting on June 17 representing kind of the new appropriations for this fiscal year. That was about 100 and I'm sorry, 211.1 million on an all funds basis since the beginning of the fiscal year per the authority granted by the council in your resolution adopting the budget staff was granted authority to carry over, as we said, encumbrances, in other words appropriations that were encumbered through contracts and purchase orders where we hadn't yet received invoices or made payment at the end of June. So those roll into this fiscal year in order to accommodate that. What is included in this report in attachment B is a recommendation for the council to authorize supplemental appropriat of 1,080,148 across a number of funds that summarize both in the staff report and in the attachment. What this represents is funding that was provided in the prior year budget for specific purposes, but for which at year end we did not have we didn't spend the money nor did we have a purchase order contract that encumbered those dollars. Yet those funds are still essentially needed for the for, for the purpose intended. And we enumerate those. The the bulk of it is our vehicle replacement fund for vehicles that were planned for replacement in last fiscal year, but either the order was in place or the invoices weren't received. Another portion of this recommendation is in our grants fund, particularly in the low mod housing fund for funding that is used for the city to for contracts to administer our below market rate rental and ownership units. So they're summarized in the report. So I'm just, I'll wrap up to take any questions you have on the first quarter report, but also again recommend that the council authorize the supplemental budget appropriation listed as second recommendation in your staff report. Thank you.
